plugins.changelogTitle:
# Changelog

Every release is generated from the commit history; see CONTRIBUTING.md for the conventions that drive it.

plugins.prepareCmd: baseline="$(sh .github/scripts/published-baseline.sh ${lastRelease.version || ''})" && dotnet pack AdCodicem.Pdf.slnx -c Release -p:Version=${nextRelease.version} -p:PackageValidationBaselineVersion="$baseline" -o artifacts && npm --prefix docs/website ci && npm --prefix docs/website run snapshot -- ${nextRelease.version}
